text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation Festival.
To express gratitude for their ongoing support,
the Umamusume entertain their fans through various competitions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still in Love was no exception, either—
choice_data_list: Huh, the entry application wasn't accepted!?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "I thought I had registered for the Obstacle Course, but it seems there was a mix-up..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...It happens from time to time. Thinking you conveyed something,
when in fact it didn't reach them at all..."
choice_data_list: I'll go find a sport that uses starting gates!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Besides, I'm sure no one is waiting for me.
choice_data_list: No, I'm here! Just wait a sec

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: S-Soccer... is it...!?
choice_data_list: Looks like an opening just came up.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I-I can't, Trainer...
Team competitions just aren't for me..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: They won't even notice me, and it'll all be over with me just standing there...!
choice_data_list: Then, let's try using that to our advantage instead.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Uwoooooh!! Hey, pass!
—Number 10 is pushing up! Fall back, fall back!
—Don't hold back! Charge, charge!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... left out of the loop as always...
At times like this, the golden rule is to keep to the edge
so as not to be a nuisance...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (...That's what I thought, but. Catching the opponent off guard...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(...The opponent's defender is... over there?
Maybe I should... try sticking close to her for now...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
A loose ball...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
!
...H-Hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble... clatter)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Whoaaa!? Red team scores!
A spectacular shot right into the goalkeeper's blind spot—!!

text_block_list.name: Opposing Team DF
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? ...!?
Wh-Where did she break in from?
...Don't tell me, from right behind me...!?

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know why, but I have a feeling getting the ball in front of the goal is the way to go! Let's go all-out on offense!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making the most of her unassuming presence, Still in Love
relentlessly scooped up loose balls and scored.
As a result—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Game over!
The winner is the Red Team!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I-I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I hope I was able to be of some help...

text_block_list.name: Teammates
text_block_list.text:
Yay!!
We won~! Everyone, bring it in for a group hug!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Congrats~!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...I need to get back to Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Still's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Lady Still...! Congratulations...!

text_block_list.name: Still's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I have witnessed your great performance
with my very own eyes...!

text_block_list.name: Still's Fan A
text_block_list.text: Lady Still is indeed the goddess of fortune for our team. We, your kin, understand that well...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Still in Love brilliantly captured the hearts of her fans through her performance.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ooohh!!
Still in Love, that's amazing...!!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: When did you even join in?! And pulling off one insane super play after another like it's nothing...! I'm officially a fan!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a Triple Tiara Umamusume!
That was such a huge surprise~~!
I'm so glad I came to watch♪

text_block_list.name: Team Captain
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, we won thanks to you!
Your jumping in to join was a huge help!
Let's definitely team up again!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: Look, everyone was waiting for you.
Look, everyone was waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Still in Love brilliantly captured the hearts of her fans through her performance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a break while walking around
the Fan Appreciation Festival—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it...
My instincts have awakened once more."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, something of great importance was confessed to me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: It's after the Kinko Sho... right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Knowing she's going to run again must have fired her up, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "After her instincts subsided, she rejoiced from the bottom of her heart, enjoying peaceful, fearless days. But once again, she found herself plunged into anguish."
choice_data_list: Maybe taking a break for a while is...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Please do not let it trouble you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"You understood at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, did you not?
In order to keep winning...
we require that girl's power."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've decided to run,
...I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, compared to before my debut...
I understand myself much better now."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I'm sure you will be able to control it flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"……Once more, I digested her words.
Her instincts had awakened... which meant I'd get to witness her breathtaking running style once again――"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. So... rest easy.
You don't have to—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "I   w o n ' t   l e t   g o"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—At that moment,
my heart skipped a huge beat.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?
Has something happened?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Because...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: She is smiling.
